in_sanskrit.name: अकास
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The infinite, unmanifest, undifferentiated, and unchanging cosmic principle that is the source of all creation and is omnipresent. It is the first element of the Panchamahabhuta. Akas is the sky or the vast, open space above the earth. It is also referred to as the ether or the aether, the medium that fills the entire universe and allows all physical matter to exist.

in_hindi.name: आकास
in_hindi.long_meaning: आकास (Aakas) is a Hindi term that translates to 'sky' or 'ether' in English. It is the first element of the Panchamahabhuta in Hinduism and represents the infinite, unmanifest, undifferentiated, and unchanging cosmic principle that is the source of all creation and is omnipresent. Akas is the vast, open space above the earth and is also referred to as the aether or the aetherial medium that fills the entire universe and allows all physical matter to exist.

in_marathi.name: Akas
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Sky, Aether, Cosmos

This name is rich in spiritual meaning, symbolizing vastness, infinite possibilities, and the eternal nature of the cosmos.
